# Methods

Data was evaluated with fastqc and determined to have nextera
transposase adapter contamination. Data was run through Nephele's QC
pipeline for adapter trimming. Trimmed data was
passed through WGSA2 pipeline in Nephele where it was decontaminated for
human reads. Assemblies fasta and bam files were passed through Nephele's virome pipelines, DiscoVir, to produce a vOTU abundance table which is used in this analysis.

# Viral analysis

## 1. Methods

Data was evaluated with fastqc and determined to have nextera transposase adapter contamination. Data was run through Nephele's QC pipeline for adapter trimming. Trimmed data was passed through WGSA2 pipeline in Nephele where it was decontaminated for human reads. Assemblies and bam files were then passed through Nephele's DiscoVir pipeline where vOTUs were generated representing unique species of the virome and iPHoP was run to call hosts for each vOTU (viral species) generated. Abundance of hosts per sample were calculated by summing the CPM (TPM equivalent) of each vOTU per host genus. Viral OTUs was used for diversity analysis and host abundances were used for differential abundance analysis. 

<br><br><br><br>

----------

## 2. Data processing 

### Import data

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

## The input data is formatted such that the first column contains rows of vOTUs.

## The remaining columns are sampleIDs containings counts or abundances of each vOTU. 

data<-read.csv("vOTU_table_cpm.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)

## The first column in the metadata contains rows of sample IDs that correspond to the samples in the input data. Each subsequent column is a different piece of metadata.

metadata<-read.csv("BSS_metadata update10FEB2025.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))
metadata[, c("ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))

metadata$Age<-as.numeric(metadata$Age)
metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration<-as.numeric(metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration)
metadata$Day<-as.numeric(metadata$Day)
metadata$Calculated.BMI<-as.numeric(metadata$Calculated.BMI)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0)

metadata$Timepoint <- factor(metadata$Timepoint,
    levels = c('Baseline','Day 0','Day 2','Day 8','Day 14','Day 28'),ordered = TRUE)



otu<-otu_table(data, taxa_are_rows=TRUE)
meta<-sample_data(metadata)

phylo_raw<-phyloseq(otu, meta)
phylo_raw_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo_raw, addtax=F)
rownames(phylo_raw_df)<-phylo_raw_df[,1]
phylo_raw_df<-dplyr::select(phylo_raw_df, -c("OTU"))
metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(phylo_raw))
phylo_raw_df<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_raw_df))
#pairwise.adonis2(phylo_raw_df~SequenceRun, data=metadata)


```

### Filtering

Filtered for prevalence (10%) and abundance (count of 10) instead of critical value to increase number of taxa analyzed. Both must be true to pass filter. 

```{r}


#critical_value <- 0.00001*sum(taxa_sums(phylo_raw))
#phylo <- filter_taxa(phylo_raw, function(x) sum(x) > critical_value, TRUE)
#phylo

phylo<-phyloseq_filter_prevalence(phylo_raw, abund.trh= 500, prev.trh=0.1, abund.type="total", threshold_condition ="OR")
phylo



```

```{r results=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=TRUE, warning=FALSE}


summary(sample_sums(phylo))

phylo_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo, addtax=F)
rownames(phylo_df)<-phylo_df[,1]
phylo_df<-dplyr::select(phylo_df, -c("OTU"))

```

<br><br><br> 

### Calculating alpha diversity

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}


## calculate alpha diversity
otu_round<-otu_table(round(phylo_df), taxa_are_rows=TRUE)
phylo_round<-phyloseq(otu_round, meta)

phy_alphadiv <- estimate_richness(phylo_round)
otu_table <- otu_table(t(phylo_round))
evenness<- diversity(otu_table)/log(specnumber(otu_table))
chao1 <- t(estimateR(otu_table))[,2]
all_alphadivs <- data.frame(phy_alphadiv, evenness, chao1)
update_sample_data <- merge(sample_data(phylo_round), all_alphadivs, by=0)
rownames(update_sample_data) <- update_sample_data$Row.names
update_sample_data$Row.names <- NULL
sample_data(phylo) <- update_sample_data
metadata<-update_sample_data


```

```{r}

all_alphadivs %>% kable(caption="<center><strong>Table X. Alpha diversity of viral OTUs.<center><strong>") %>% kable_styling() %>% 
  scroll_box(width = "750px", height="650px", fixed_thead=T)

```

# Viral hosts

## Data processing

### Import data

Import data and create phyloseq.

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

## The input data is formatted such that the first column contains rows of host genera, followed by columns "kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","OTU" to be used for taxonomy in phyloseq object. OTU is in this case is genus. 

## The remaining columns are sampleIDs containings counts or abundances of each host genera. 

data<-read.csv("Host_cpm.csv")

taxa <- data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","OTU")]

taxa<-data.frame(unique(taxa))
data[, c("kingdom","phylum","class","order","family","genus","species","OTU","ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL 

rownames(taxa)<-taxa$OTU


data<-data.frame(aggregate(.~Host_genus,data=data,FUN=sum))



rownames(data)<-data[,1]
data[,1]<-NULL


```
 

```{r warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
metadata<-read.csv("BSS_metadata update10FEB2025.csv", row.names=1, header=TRUE)
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))
metadata[, c("ATCCMSA2002control_P1","ATCCMSA2002control_P2","NegativeControl","NegativeControl_P2")] <- NULL
metadata<-as.data.frame(t(metadata))

metadata$Age<-as.numeric(metadata$Age)
metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration<-as.numeric(metadata$Day.of.sample.relative.to.BSS.administration)
metadata$Day<-as.numeric(metadata$Day)
metadata$Calculated.BMI<-as.numeric(metadata$Calculated.BMI)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_bl)
metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0<-as.numeric(metadata$Days_colonoscopy_day0)


otu<-otu_table(data, taxa_are_rows=TRUE)
meta<-sample_data(metadata)

tax<-tax_table(as.matrix(taxa))

phylo_raw<-phyloseq(otu, meta, tax)
phylo_raw_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo_raw, addtax=F)
rownames(phylo_raw_df)<-phylo_raw_df[,1]
phylo_raw_df<-dplyr::select(phylo_raw_df, -c("OTU"))
metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(phylo_raw))
phylo_raw_df<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_raw_df))
#pairwise.adonis2(phylo_raw_df~SequenceRun, data=metadata)

phylo_raw

```

### Filtering

Filtered for prevalence (10%) and abundance (CPM of 3). 

```{r}


#critical_value <- 0.00001*sum(taxa_sums(phylo_raw))
#phylo <- filter_taxa(phylo_raw, function(x) sum(x) > critical_value, TRUE)
#phylo

phylo<-phyloseq_filter_prevalence(phylo_raw, abund.trh= 3, prev.trh=0.1, abund.type="total", threshold_condition ="AND")
phylo
summary(sample_sums(phylo))


```


```{r results=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=TRUE, warning=FALSE}

phylo_df<-phyloseq_to_df(phylo, addtax=F)
rownames(phylo_df)<-phylo_df[,1]
phylo_df<-dplyr::select(phylo_df, -c("OTU"))

```

## 3. Beta diversity 

Differences between time point (baseline, day0, Day2, Day8, Day14, Day28)

### 3.1 PERMANOVA

#### 3.1.1 Bray-Curtis

```{r}

phylo_df<-as.data.frame(t(phylo_df))
bray<-pairwise.adonis2(phylo_df~Timepoint, data=metadata)

results_df <- do.call(rbind, bray)
results_df <- results_df[grepl("Model", rownames(results_df)), ]
results_df$Comparison<-rownames(results_df)
results_df<- results_df %>% mutate(Comparison = gsub(".Model", "", Comparison))
rownames(results_df)<-results_df$Comparison

results_df<-results_df %>% mutate_at(1:5, as.numeric)
results_df[c(1:5)] <- lapply(results_df[c(1:5)], round, digits = 3)

results_df[,c(1,2,6)]<-NULL
results_df %>% kable(caption="<strong>Table X. Differences in viruses by host using Bray-Curtis Dissimilarity.<strong>", format="html", full_width = FALSE, table.attr= "style='width:80%;'") %>% kable_styling(position="left", bootstrap_options = c("striped"))%>%
   column_spec(4, color=ifelse(results_df[,3] < 0.05, "green","black"))


library(downloadthis)
results_df %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "PERMANOVAresults-virus-host-bray",
    output_extension = ".xlsx",
    button_label = "Download results in excel",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )


```

<br>

## 4. Differential abundance 

Used Maaslin2 to look for differentially abundant taxa between timepoints after BSS and day 0 using a linear model ("LM"). SubjectID and Sequence Run were incorporated as random effects.

```{r results=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, cache=TRUE}

library(Maaslin2)

metadata<-data.frame(sample_data(phylo))

subject_all = Maaslin2(
  input_data = phylo_df,
  input_metadata = metadata, 
  output = "Timepoint_DAA_LM_Day0_hosts",
  fixed_effects = c('Timepoint'), normalization="NONE", reference=c("Timepoint,Day 0"), random_effect=c("SubjectID", "SequenceRun"), analysis_method="LM", transform="LOG", plot_scatter = FALSE)

LM<-subject_all$results


## re-install maaslin2 to fix package error. Log transform with linear model? 

table<-as.data.frame(LM[,c("feature","value","coef","qval","N.not.zero")])
table$OTU<-table$feature
#write.csv(DAA_taxa, "DAA_species.csv")

DAA_taxa<-merge.data.frame(table, taxa, by="OTU", all.x=TRUE, all.y=FALSE)
#write.csv(DAA_taxa, "DAA_species.csv")

```

```{r}

table_sub<- DAA_taxa %>% filter(qval < 0.05)
table_sub2<- table_sub %>% filter(coef< -1)
table_sub3<- table_sub %>% filter(coef > 1)
table_sub4<-rbind(table_sub2, table_sub3)

table_sub4[table_sub4=="p__Firmicutes_A"] <- "Bacillota"
table_sub4[table_sub4=="p__Firmicutes_C"] <- "Bacillota"
table_sub4[table_sub4=="p__Firmicutes"] <- "Bacillota"
table_sub4[table_sub4=="p__Bacteroidota"] <- "Bacteroidota"
table_sub4[table_sub4=="p__Proteobacteria"] <- "Pseudomonadota"


table_sub4$phylum<- factor(table_sub4$phylum,
    levels = c('Bacillota','Bacteroidota','Pseudomonadota'), ordered = TRUE)


table_sub4<- table_sub4 %>% mutate(genus = gsub("f__", " ", genus))
table_sub4<- table_sub4 %>% mutate(genus = gsub("g__", " ", genus))

table_sub4<- table_sub4 %>% mutate(family = gsub("f__", " ", family))
table_sub4<- table_sub4 %>% mutate(order = gsub("o__", " ", order))
table_sub4<- table_sub4 %>% mutate(class = gsub("c__", " ", class))


###### 

table_sub5<-table_sub4[,c(12,4,5,8:11)] 
names(table_sub5)[1]<-"Viral host"


table_sub5$qval<-formatC(table_sub5$qval, format = "e", digits = 2)
table_sub5$coef<-round(table_sub5$coef, digits = 2)

table_sub5 <- table_sub5[order(table_sub5$qval, decreasing=FALSE),]

dust(table_sub5) %>%
  kable(caption = "<strong>Table X. Differentially abundant viruses by host at day 2 compared to day 0.<strong>") %>% column_spec(column=3, width_min="5em", include_thead = T)  %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped")) %>% 
  scroll_box(width = "800px", height="650px", fixed_thead=T)


library(downloadthis)
table_sub5 %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "Differentally abundant viruses by host",
    output_extension = ".xlsx",
    button_label = "Download results in excel",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa fa-save"
  )

```

### 4.1 Viral barchart 

```{r}

mycolors <- c("#2D82AF","#98D277","#D9A295")

table_sub4<- table_sub4 %>% mutate(updated_text = gsub("f__", " ", genus))

table_sub4<- table_sub4 %>% mutate(updated_text = gsub("g__", " ", updated_text))


table_sub4$updated_text<- factor(table_sub4$updated_text, levels = table_sub4$updated_text[order(table_sub4$phylum, table_sub4$coef, decreasing=TRUE)])

stacked_species<-ggplot(table_sub4, aes(x = coef, y = updated_text, fill=phylum)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",show.legend = TRUE) + xlab("Effect size") +scale_fill_manual(values=mycolors)+theme_classic()+geom_col(color="black")+theme(legend.position="bottom")+ylab(NULL)

#stacked_species



```


```{r}


table_sub4$qval_adj<--log10(table_sub4$qval)

bubble_species<-ggplot(table_sub4, aes(x=value, y=updated_text, size = qval_adj)) + geom_point(alpha=1, aes(color=phylum))+scale_size_area(breaks=c(2,3,4,5), "Significance")+scale_color_manual(values=mycolors)+theme_void()+guides(color="none", fill="none")

#bubble_species


#ggexport(stacked_species+bubble_species, filename="Stacked_plot_genus_hosts_w_qval_v2.pdf",width=5, height=6)


```


```{r fig.width=6, fig.height=8, fig.cap="**Figure X. Differentially abundant functional pathways (effect size > 1 or <  - 1) 2 days (day 2) after compared to day before (day 0) BSS administration. Significance represents -log10 of adjusted p value after multiple comparisons (< 0.05). The greater the circle the more statistically significant.**"}

stacked_species+bubble_species
figure<-stacked_species+bubble_species



library(downloadthis)
figure %>%
  download_this(
    output_name = "Stacked_plot_viral_host",
    output_extension = ".pdf",
    button_label = "Download figure as .pdf",
    button_type = "default",
    has_icon = TRUE,
    icon = "fa-solid fa-image",
    ggsave_args = list(height=8, width=8)
  )
